user.title: Set up Volcast
user.description: Connect your Volcast account, or only run a read-only discovery of your installation (nothing is changed and nothing leaves Home Assistant until you share the diagnostics file).

pair.title: Connect your Volcast account
pair.description: Open the Volcast app or page and confirm this connection there. This window closes by itself once you confirm.

data_description.pairing_url: Leave empty to use the default Volcast service. Change it only if Volcast support asked you to.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Only needed if Volcast support asked you to use another pairing service.

data_description.pairing_url: Leave empty to use the default Volcast service.

api_key.title: Connect to Volcast
api_key.description: Enter your Volcast API key. You can find it in the Volcast app under Settings > API Key.

production.title: Production Tracking (optional)
production.description:
Connect your inverter sensors to improve forecast accuracy. Volcast will send hourly production summaries for calibration.

Both are optional — you can configure them later in integration options.

data_description.pv_energy_entity: A sensor that shows today's total solar production in kWh (resets daily). This is the primary source for tracking — look for sensors like "Today's PV Generation" or "Daily Yield" from your inverter (GoodWe, Fronius, SolarEdge, Huawei, SMA, Enphase).
data_description.pv_power_entity: A sensor that shows current solar power output in watts. Used as a fallback when the energy sensor is unavailable or resets mid-day.
data_description.battery_soc_entity: A sensor that shows battery state of charge (0-100%). Used to detect inverter curtailment when the battery is full. Optional — only needed if you have a battery system.
data_description.battery_charge_power_entity: A sensor that shows battery charging power in watts. Used to confirm curtailment (battery full, not accepting charge) and detect grid charging (negative price scenarios). Optional.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Volcast API. Check your internet connection.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API key or premium subscription required.
error.masked_key: This looks like the shortened preview from the app (vk_xxxx...xxxx), not the full key. In the Volcast app open Settings > API Key and use the Copy or Share button, then paste the full 67-character key here.
error.invalid_key_format: That is not a Volcast API key. A key starts with vk_ and is 67 characters long. Use the Copy or Share button in the Volcast app under Settings > API Key.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full https:// address without a trailing slash.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Volcast is already set up here, and installation discovery already runs as part of it.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Volcast pairing service. Check your internet connection and try again.
abort.pairing_expired: The pairing request expired or was cancelled before it was confirmed. Start again and confirm within 10 minutes.
abort.pairing_disabled: Pairing is not available right now. Try again later, or connect with an API key.
abort.pairing_failed: Pairing did not complete. Start again; if it keeps failing, connect with an API key.
abort.paired_existing: Your existing Volcast entry is now connected to your account.
abort.multiple_accounts: More than one Volcast entry is set up here. Remove the extra entries, then pair again.
abort.pairing_connection_lost: Home Assistant lost the connection to the Volcast pairing service while waiting for your confirmation. Check the internet connection of Home Assistant and start again.
abort.already_in_progress: Volcast setup is already in progress. Finish or close the other setup window first.
abort.existing_entry_disabled: Volcast is already added but disabled. Enable it in Settings → Devices & services.
abort.converted_existing: Your discovery-only entry now uses your Volcast account.

data_description.pv_power_entity: A sensor that shows current solar power output in watts. Used as fallback.

control.title: Inverter control
control.description: Through your inverter integration — Volcast writes the inverter's mode and power entities. Directly — Volcast talks to the inverter over the local network; available only for inverters whose direct control is verified and when no other integration uses the inverter (search for it under Installation details first). Control also needs the switch in Home Assistant and your consent in the Volcast app.

details.title: Installation details
details.description: Optional. Pick sensors for the readings Volcast cannot find through the inverter integration, and correct the installation data.

data.grid_power_negate: Grid sensor shows export as positive
data.direct_search: Search for the inverter on the local network

data_description.grid_power_negate: Turn on when your grid sensor is negative while importing.
data_description.load_energy_entity: Used once to send your consumption history to Volcast.
data_description.direct_search: Reads the inverter's identification only; nothing is written.
data_description.direct_trial: Connects to the inverter, shows its readings and what Volcast would do — never writes. Only for inverters whose direct control is still being verified.

prices.title: Energy prices
prices.description: Only sensors that already provide a complete price series are listed.

data.price_currency: Currency (when the sensor does not say)

direct_pick.title: Inverter found
direct_pick.description: Pick the inverter to connect to directly. "test only" means direct control of this model is not verified yet — only the read-only test connection is available.

direct_manual.title: Inverter address
direct_manual.description: Enter the local address of the inverter or its data logger. Volcast reads its identification before saving.

data_description.host: A private network address, for example of the inverter's Wi-Fi or LAN module.
data_description.logger_serial: Required for Solarman data loggers (up to 10 digits).

abort.entity_mode_unavailable: Inverter control entities not found. Control through the integration needs a supported inverter integration with an entity for every setting.
abort.direct_unverified: Direct control is not available for this inverter yet — its model has not been verified. You can use the read-only test connection under Installation details.
abort.direct_conflict: Another integration ({integration}) uses this inverter. Disable it before choosing direct control, so two programs do not control the inverter at the same time.
abort.direct_not_found: No inverter found yet. Search for it under Installation details first.
abort.direct_in_use: Another Volcast entry already connects to this inverter.

error.prices_not_usable: This sensor does not provide a complete price series right now.
error.currency_invalid: Use a three-letter currency code, for example PLN or EUR.
error.trial_with_entities: The test connection cannot run while control goes through the inverter integration.
error.trial_while_owned: Volcast still controls the inverter from an earlier session. Turn control off and wait until the inverter is back in its own mode.
error.invalid_host: Enter a local IP address (a host name or a public address is not accepted).
error.logger_serial_required: Enter the data logger serial number (up to 10 digits).
error.direct_not_found: No supported inverter answered at this address.

progress.direct_search: Searching the local network for the inverter. This can take up to a minute.

production_tracking_available.title: Improve forecast accuracy with production tracking
production_tracking_available.description: Volcast v1.5.0 can now track your actual PV production and use it to calibrate forecasts. Go to the integration options and select your inverter's energy or power sensor to enable this feature.

foreign_control.title: Volcast inverter control paused
foreign_control.description: An inverter setting controlled by Volcast ({entity_id}) was changed outside Volcast. Volcast paused control for 30 minutes and keeps the settings you changed. Control resumes automatically afterwards; to stop it, turn off the Volcast control switch.

direct_identity_changed.title: Volcast found a different inverter at the saved address
direct_identity_changed.description: The inverter at this address is a different device. Volcast stopped reading and controlling it. Search for your inverter again in the integration options.

control_error.title: Volcast cannot control the inverter
control_error.description: Volcast inverter control stopped working (repeated write errors or saved control state that could not be read). The inverter may still use the last settings Volcast applied. Check the inverter settings and the Home Assistant logs.

foreign_control_direct.title: Volcast inverter control paused
foreign_control_direct.description: An inverter setting controlled by Volcast ({setting}) was changed outside Volcast. Volcast paused control for 30 minutes and keeps the setting you changed. Control resumes automatically afterwards; to stop it, turn off the Volcast control switch.

direct_conflict.title: Another client is using the inverter connection
direct_conflict.description: Volcast detected another client talking to the inverter over the same connection ({reason}). Volcast stopped writing its plan and reads less often; returning the inverter to its own settings still works. Disable the other integration or device that talks to the inverter; the warning clears after 30 minutes without signs of another client.

nvm_budget.title: Volcast inverter write budget used up
nvm_budget.description: Volcast reached its daily limit of writes to the inverter's memory. It holds the current settings (a forced charge or discharge returns to the inverter's own mode) until older writes leave the 24-hour window.

tou_snapshot_lost.title: Volcast lost the saved copy of your inverter schedule
tou_snapshot_lost.description: Volcast could not read its saved copy of the time-of-use programs you had before Volcast took control. When control ends, Volcast will set simple self-consumption programs and turn the inverter's time-of-use schedule off. Check and re-enter your own schedule on the inverter afterwards.

sync_production.name: Sync production
sync_production.description: Force-syncs hourly PV production to Volcast using Home Assistant recorder statistics. Fills gaps left by HA downtime (e.g. a system update). Without a date, syncs yesterday and today.

date.name: Date
date.description: Specific day to sync (must be within the last ~24-38 hours). Leave empty to sync yesterday and today.
